hypothesis: W-R22's 100% mask-aware performance may rely on the exact 4-channel zero sentinel encoding missing observations. Test the same frozen trained models without retraining on unseen missing-position patterns filled with zero, last observed row, or constant 127.
freeze: All three imputations, mask counts, positions, exact seed cohorts, trained source and thresholds fixed before any first-use execution; never retrain on original W-R22 heldout or adapt to new results.
training: Import W-R22 source and train exactly its four original 16-feature models on original development seeds 240..255, 1728 paired examples and 32 epochs per model. No change to model parameters/width/capacity.
mechanism: Produce same four observed channels and positive/negative candidate multiset. Change masked rows using frozen per-policy fill prior to swapping the two untouched observation rows. No missingness flag supplied to either feature model; W-R22 mask-aware recognizes exactly all-four-zero rows.
primary: Per model/fill x heldout cell per-seed confusion and total accuracy. ROBUST_IMPUTATION if frozen maskaware_augmented accuracy>=.80 in each of three imputation groups; SENTINEL_DEPENDENT if zero-fill accuracy>=.90 and both nonzero-fill groups<=.70; MIXED otherwise. Record naive baselines and all adverse outcomes.
controls: Never mask anchor t0 or swapped actual observation rows t11,t12,t13,t14
Matched positive/negative candidate same first row/multiset after filling
No adaptation, training examples, model calls, extra sensors or first-use reruns
Original first-use archive before one full Go regression
Exact parent Git identity plus prereg and evaluator blob hashes
claim_limit: Finite deterministic synthetic missing-data representation study, not generalized cognition.
